title: Pumpkin slices
description: Added edible pumpkins to the game.
body:
🎃 Pumpkin Slice Mod
A simple Fabric mod that adds pumpkin slices – works exactly like melon slices, but with higher hunger & saturation.

Features
Restores 3 hunger (3.6 saturation)

Drop from breaking pumpkins: 3–7 slices (affected by Fortune)

Silk Touch drops the pumpkin block

Crafting: 9 slices → 1 pumpkin, 1 slice → 1 pumpkin seed

Compostable (50%), fox food, stacks to 64

Minecraft 1.20.1, requires Fabric API
